hero.title: Enterprise analytics for modern teams
hero.subtitle: Prodesk Cloud connects your product data, enriches it in real time, and gives teams the dashboards, alerts, and workflows they need to ship with confidence.

image.alt: Analytics dashboard showing product usage metrics, conversion funnels, and retention curves.

features.title: Real-time dashboards out of the box
features.subtitle: Monitor signups, retention, funnels, and feature adoption with live, streaming dashboards.

items.title: Streaming product analytics
items.body: Capture and route product events to your warehouse, BI tools, and CDP without custom scripts.

items.title: Intelligent alerts
items.body: Get notified only when metrics behave abnormally, with built-in anomaly detection and context.

items.title: Guided instrumentation
items.body: Work with solutions engineers to define events, tracking plans, and dashboards teams can trust.

services.title: From integration to adoption
services.subtitle: Our team works with you from first event to first experiment, so you never ship dashboards in the dark.

items.title: Implementation & migration
items.body: Migrate from legacy tools, connect sources, and launch your core dashboards in under a week.

items.title: Governance & reliability
items.body: Establish tracking plans, data contracts, and SLAs so stakeholders trust every metric.

items.title: Enablement & training
items.body: Upskill product, growth, and customer teams with hands-on workshops, demos, and office hours.

why.title: A shared source of truth for product-led teams
why.subtitle: Align product, growth, and revenue around the same dashboards, the same metrics, and the same experiments.

items.title: Built for modern stacks
items.body: Prodesk Cloud integrates with warehouses, CDPs, and messaging providers so you can keep your current stack and centralize your metrics.

items.title: Enterprise-grade controls
items.body: Single sign-on, audit logs, and regional data residency help you ship with governance in mind.

items.title: Operational reliability
items.body: Enterprise SLAs, global edge infrastructure, and automated incident response keep your dashboards online.

items.quote: Prodesk Cloud completely unified our fragmented data stack. Our product, engineering, and revenue teams finally have a single source of truth that updates in real-time.
items.name: Sarah Jenkins
items.avatarAlt: Sarah Jenkins, Director of Data Platform at NexusFlow

items.quote: We transitioned from relying on batch processing to running live, structured experiments. The querying engine is incredibly fast, trustworthy, and heavily adopted across the org.
items.name: David Park
items.avatarAlt: David Park, Lead Analytics Engineer at ScaleGrid

pricing.title: Start where you are, scale when you're ready
pricing.subtitle: Transparent plans for growing teams, with enterprise options when you need deeper control.

items.question: How quickly can we go live?
items.answer: Most teams connect their sources, define core events, and ship their first dashboards in under a week. Smaller teams can often go live the same day.

items.question: How does Prodesk Cloud integrate with our stack?
items.answer: Prodesk Cloud integrates with modern warehouses, CDPs, and messaging providers so you can keep your current stack and centralize your metrics.

items.question: What about security and compliance?
items.answer: We offer SSO, audit logs, data residency options, and strict access controls. Our team can work with your security and legal stakeholders during evaluation.
